pendingDescription: Registration received or pending. Drafts stay private until admin approval.
toursDescription: Review published, draft, and paused tours for this community.
tourEmptyBody: Create a draft or adjust filters to see other tours.
demoModeBody: Without a signed-in guide, the dashboard uses the first seeded guide to test the local queue.
noUpcomingBody: Bookings created in the tourist flow will appear here for guide confirmation.
bookingQueueEmptyBody: Create a booking as a tourist to validate guide confirmation, cancellation, and check-in.
cancelReason: Cancelled by the guide in the local MVP
createTourDescription: The tour starts as a draft and should only become public after manual guide approval.
publishTourDescription: A verified guide publishes the tour through Firebase. The Function checks community, hills, languages, and route points before writing.
remoteCreateError: Could not create the tour right now.
bookingNotFoundBody: This booking does not belong to the active guide, another community, or has not synced on this device yet.
guideCancelPolicyAvailable: The guide can still cancel this booking before the start time.
guideCancelPolicyLocked: This booking can no longer be cancelled through self-service.
checkInPolicyLocked: Check-in opens 2h before the start time and only after confirmation.
